items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Charlie Barnett, and Bunny was dancing with that band for a while.

ctx.x: And they used to call that 'around the world.' You're going around the world circuit. So if you got those four weeks, you were doing pretty good, you know, back then. Of course, you played for choruses of chorus girls, and you'd have comedians, and you'd have dancers, tap dancers on almost all of those shows.
I remember Bunny Briggs when he was a young kid doing those things back there then. And the strange thing about Bunny, I worked with Charlie Barnett, and Bunny was dancing with that band for a while.
(Inaudible) Was he singing then at all?
